headline: Proxy Advisor Glass Lewis Challenges Executive Pay Proposals at South African Listed Firms
summary: Governance advisory firm Glass Lewis raised concerns over executive remuneration policies at South Africa's Woolworths Holdings and Momentum Metropolitan, urging full disclosure to shareholders.
why: Institutional proxy advisory recommendations influence shareholder votes and executive compensation policies in listed firms.

impacts.name: Woolworths Holdings
impacts.why: Governance scrutiny from Glass Lewis may lead to shareholder pushback on executive pay proposals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
